title: Shape showcase
description: Every generator in one place: lathe, sweep with twist, extrude, tubes along knots and helices.

title: Smartphone
description: Studio product shot: squircle bodies with polished metal frames, a textured home screen under glass, softbox reflections and a stepped triple camera.

title: Skeleton watch
description: A mechanical skeleton watch at 10:10: spoked brass gears (extrude with holes), a hairspring (tube along a spiral), blued screws, ruby jewels, polished steel and a leather strap.

title: Turbofan cutaway
description: A turbofan with the casing cut open: 22 twisted fan blades, booster and high-pressure compressor stages, a glowing combustor, heat-tinted turbines, all as radial arrays of NACA-profiled blades.

title: Fairground at dusk
description: A whole fairground in motion: a Ferris wheel whose gondolas stay upright, a carousel with galloping horses, a wave swinger, a roller coaster train riding its track on spline keyframes with real lift and drop speeds, fireworks, rising balloons and hundreds of lights.

title: Plush dancer
description: A fluffy plush character with headphones dancing on a light-up floor: fur from surface noise, a baked skeleton (root bounce, sway and twist, arm and leg swings) turned into keyframes for every part, a disco ball and pumping speakers.

title: Neon district
description: A rainy cyberpunk street at night: towers with thousands of lit windows, flickering neon signs mirrored on the wet asphalt, rain, flying cars in traffic lanes, an elevated train crossing, swinging lanterns and a giant rotating hologram in the haze.

title: Photographer's desk
description: A vintage rangefinder camera on a walnut desk, modelled at real scale: pebbled leather, satin chrome, knurled dials and a coated lens, next to an espresso on a marble coaster, a cloth-bound notebook, a pencil and a film canister. Every surface is a procedural pattern with relief, no image files.

title: Café racer garage
description: A café racer on a paddock stand in a workshop at night, at real scale: wire-spoke wheels with tread, a finned parallel twin, chrome headers into megaphone silencers, a glossy tank, a leather hump seat, chain and shocks; brick wall, sealed concrete, a workbench with tools and a swinging work lamp. The rear wheel spins on the stand.

title: Seagrass meadow
description: An ambient underwater world: a seagrass meadow of 35,000 blades swaying in the current (wind bends every vertex), tall kelp, rocks, two schools of fish, drifting plankton and volumetric light shafts through the water, seen from a slowly gliding drone.

title: Castle
description: Curtain walls with 48 merlons, four towers, a keep, gatehouse, moat ring, bridge and a forest. About 190 objects.

title: Chess set
description: Italian opening on a wooden board. Every piece is a lathe profile, the knights are extruded silhouettes.

title: Space station
description: A rotating-wheel station with spokes, solar wings, docking modules, an antenna dish, an approaching shuttle and a ringed planet.

title: City block
description: A procedural downtown: 36 blocks, towers with setbacks, round glass towers, rooftop details and a park with a pond.

title: Alien garden
description: Tapered sweeps along procedural curves, glowing mushrooms, spiral shells and crystals, all placed on the terrain with probe_height.

title: Lighthouse island
description: A noise terrain island; the lighthouse and boat were placed on the surface and on the water with probe_height.
